items.description:
Abide is a weekend camping retreat for young adults ages 18 to 35 at Ellijay SDA Church’s McKinney Park, centered on worship, rest, community, and time outdoors. The weekend will include campfire worship, Sabbath morning worship, hiking, shared meals, and plenty of time to slow down and spend time together. Meals will be provided from Friday evening through Sunday morning. Attendees are responsible for bringing their own tent, sleeping gear, camp chair, and other personal camping supplies. Weekend registration is $40 per person, with a $15 Sabbath-only option available for those who would like to spend the day with the group without camping overnight. Registration is required by October 11.

Join AdventHealth Redmond for the Night of Hope 2026! This free, family-friendly concert is designed to bring the local community together for an uplifting evening of music and fellowship. The outdoor event will feature live performances by renowned Christian music artists Pat Barrett and Naomi Raine, two of today's most celebrated voices in contemporary worship. It will be a wonderful opportunity to gather at Ridge Ferry Park for a fun-filled night of inspiring stories, community connection, and great music.

items.description:
Join fellow young adults ages 18 to 35 for the 2026 Young Adult LIFE Retreat: STRONGER TOGETHER at Cohutta Springs Youth Camp. This year merges Adventist Christian Fellowship with the annual retreat for an all-encompassing weekend of fun, edification, and connection with Jesus, featuring messages from Angelo Grasso. Meals will be provided all day Sabbath and Sunday morning, but please note that no meal is provided on Friday night, so plan accordingly. If you are staying in the dorm style cabins, remember to bring your own bedding for a single bed, towels, and toiletries. Please complete your registration by the deadline on September 27, 2026
